allow_large: One code file (close.py); the rest are tests, which the owner decided on 2026-10-01 don't count toward the fix limit (that change is still landing)
done_when: When nothing blocks, the pull request's review block opens with one plain line, 'Review: clean' followed by how many findings were dismissed and how many are advice, and puts the dismissed and advisory findings with their reasons inside a collapsed details section; a review with open blocking findings still lists them plainly first. A command-level test renders both cases.

findings.body: The collapsed section includes advisory titles and locations followed only by `advisory`; it never includes their reasons from `finding['body']`. For example, the command-test fixture supplies `Evidence for: Simpler: drop the cache` in tests/test_close.py:62, but that explanation disappears from the PR body. This leaves the explicit requirement to include advisory findings with their reasons unmet. Include those explanations inside the details section and assert their presence in the command-level test.
findings.title: Not done: When nothing blocks, the pull request's review block opens with one plain line, 'Review: clean' followed by how many findings were

findings.body: Separating blockers from other findings creates gaps in each Markdown ordered list. With findings 1=P1, 2=P2 and 3=P1, the visible blockers render as 1 and 2 rather than 1 and 3: [GitHub's Markdown contract](https://github.github.com/gfm/#lists) disregards subsequent list-marker numbers. Dismissals still use original indices (src/forge/close.py:107–114), so copying a displayed number can dismiss the wrong finding. This is new rendering evidence relevant to the ruling that original numbers must remain intact. Use literal number labels that Markdown cannot renumber.
findings.title: Preserve finding numbers after GitHub renders the split lists

why: The pull request body lists dismissed and advisory review findings as numbered items, so an owner reading it sees open-looking issues on a change whose review is clean, and won't merge
